title: What Happened, and What Was Going On
label: ch:sa-what-happened-and-what-was-going-on
canDo: I can say what someone did, with the past that follows the doer (saḥ gatavān, sā gatavatī), and what was going on at the time (saḥ paṭhati sma; yadā … tadā …).

payoff.summary: Complete SA-R276-what-happened: say what happened and what was going on when it happened.
